_note: Stage B wave 3, Norway repairs: the OSL leg of 13 topics whose other markets are not rerun. Each is rerun with --exit-method drop so it matches its sibling markets (no exit_method key anywhere in the topic), on today's period accounting and truncation labels. Gate: --check det --det-mode drop, 2 runs a leg (drop, drop.rep). Install the drop run under the _outputs name, then fold it into the comparison file with scripts/rebuild_comparison.py <topic> --only OSL: every chart script here reads Norway from the OSL node of exchange_comparison.json, and --only reads results/returns_OSL.json and leaves every other node byte-identical. _outputs is a list where the same run is installed under two names. pairs is unused by det (load_legs needs one). See scripts/LTP_GATE.md.

earnings-consistency._source: --exchange OSL (no longer in --global presets_to_run). Live: returns_OSL.json equals the OSL node; the comparison post cites it as 100% cash
